lines.text: Up 40% in a week: Xatu - 059 [Staff] (Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards) went from $22.49 on Nov 20 to $31.48 on Nov 27. It is still 48% under its peak of $60.00 on May 2, 2024.
Sneasel (30th Celebration Classic Collection) 25/111: $2.75 (Nov 20) to $1.74 (Nov 27) on TCGplayer market. Down 37%.
Power Partnership Tin [Mewtwo & Mew GX]: $944.48 (Nov 20) to $1,044.78 (Nov 27) on TCGplayer market. Up 11%.
Scarlet & Violet 151, about 30 days: 1 of 29 priced cards up 10% or more, 11 down 10% or more. Start prices Oct 28, end Nov 27, TCGplayer market.
Mega Evolution - Flowing Fists: release date Feb 6, 2027, per PokeGuardian.
